description: Design a high-CTR 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Overlay text is a post-production suggestion (image models render text unreliably).

inputs.name: channel_style
inputs.default: bold, high contrast, bright colors, clean design, YouTube tech aesthetic

phases.prompt: Build a YouTube thumbnail image prompt. Subject: use {{subject_description}} if provided, otherwise design an object/scene that dramatizes the topic: {{title}}. Mood derives from {{channel_style}}. Composition: rule-of-thirds, subject on left or right with empty space for text. Do NOT bake in heavy text (image text rendering is unreliable). Style tags: {{channel_style}}, youtube thumbnail composition, ultra detailed, vibrant, high contrast, 16:9.
